newsitem.title: USA: Japanese to keep investing in U.S. bonds - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Japanese to keep investing in U.S. bonds - WSJ.

text.p: Despite recent Wall Street speculation, Japanese institutional investors insist they are buying more U.S. bonds than they have in years and plan to keep buying them, The Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
Triggering last week's drop in global financial markets was the rumor that big Japanese investors might stop buying U.S. bonds, which might force up U.S. interest rates, the story says.
But fund managers in Japan said interest rates are so low in Japan that they have to put more money overseas, especially in blue-chip securities like U.S. Treasury bonds, the story says.
